EV12138/zcode-tokmon.body:
# Tokmon

**ZCode Token Monitor** — A token usage and generation rate monitoring plugin for both local and SSH remote hosts.

> **English** — Tokmon is a ZCode plugin that monitors token usage and generation throughput on your machine and across SSH remote hosts. Core features (MCP tool, slash commands, terminal dashboard) never modify client files; the floating status bar is opt-in and can be removed byte-for-byte.

Tokmon (**Tok**en **Mon**itor) turns ZCode's token consumption and generation speed into data that is always visible, queryable, and aggregatable across machines: local sessions, SSH remote hosts, sub-agents, and today's totals. One status bar, one MCP tool, and one terminal panel give you full visibility into all of it.

## Why Tokmon

- **Zero intrusion at the core**: The MCP tool, the `/usage` command, and the `/usage-watch` terminal panel do not modify ZCode client files.
- **SSH remote is a first-class citizen**: It is not an "add-on query" but runs on the same data pipeline as local. Sessions are routed precisely by session ID, and if the local database has no match, the query is handed off to the remote host.
- **Automatic remote deployment**: On the first query, a lightweight agent is automatically pushed to the remote `~/.zcode/token-monitor/agent.py`, verified by SHA256, and automatically updated on version mismatch. No manual script copying is needed.
- **SSH connection reuse**: ControlMaster + ControlPersist means polling no longer performs a fresh handshake every time. Changes to `config.json` / ZCode `setting.json` automatically hot-reload targets, and newly connected remote workspaces need no restart of the data pump.
- **Verifiable metrics**: Rates, context, and today's summary each have independent SQL cross-checks and unit tests, rather than relying on "looks about right."
- **Optional floating bar**: If you want the live monitoring bar below the input box, install it explicitly. After uninstalling, `app.asar` is byte-for-byte identical to the official version (verified by sha256 round trip).

## Features

- **Live rate**: ⚡ tok/s, taken precisely for the current session; pulse indicator while generating; cache hit rate directly reflects input reuse.
- **Session total**: 💬 cumulative tokens for the current session (excludes sub-agents, which are separate sessions).
- **Context length**: ⏱ input tokens of the most recently completed request (including cache reads), i.e., the base context for the next turn. The window is taken from **the model's own context length in ZCode's model settings** (model rules take precedence, with the provider's model catalog as fallback, by…

## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

# Legado with MD3

## 📖 Introduction

**Legado with MD3** is a Material Design 3-style refactored version developed from the open-source project [阅读 (Legado)](https://github.com/gedoor/legado).

In addition to redrawing the UI, this project adds many branch-exclusive features and is gradually migrating from traditional View to the Jetpack Compose framework, with the goal of providing a more modern, smooth, and consistent reading experience.

> [!CAUTION]
> **Notes:**
> Because the theme system was refactored using the Monet engine, the official version's themes are no longer available in this version.
>
> **Devices below Android 12:**
> Custom themes and dynamic color extraction are temporarily unavailable. This limitation will be resolved after the Jetpack Compose migration is complete (due to limited developer bandwidth, the migration will take a long time).

---

## ✨ Branch Features

Compared with the official version, this project has the following exclusive features:

* **New theme:** A brand-new Material Design 3 interface, supporting **predictive back gesture** and **shared element animations**.
* **Reading interface:** More personalized reading interface and menu configuration.
* **Reading records:** Detailed reading records, supporting **timeline** and **per-chapter** statistics.
* **Experience enhancements:** More robust **comic reading**, **audiobook**, and **discover** interface experiences.
* **Bookshelf layout:** More bookshelf layout options, with dedicated interface optimizations for **tablets**.
* **Practical features:** Newly added book notes, smart companion grouping (automatically sorts read/unread books), and support for **gamepad** up/down **page turning**.

---

## 🛠️ Core Features

1. **Multi-format support:** Supports reading local TXT and EPUB files, with smart scanning of local files.
2. **Highly customizable:** Switch fonts, backgrounds, line spacing, paragraph spacing, bold, Simplified/Traditional Chinese conversion, etc.
3. **Content purification and replacement:** Powerfully removes ads and replaces body text content.
4. **Page-turning modes:** Cover, simulation, slide, scroll, and other modes can be switched freely.
5. **Fully open source:** No ads, continuous iteration and optimization.

---

# dart-insight

A disclosure analysis web service that compares two DART periodic reports and shows the changed financial figures and sentences alongside the original source evidence. It lets people unfamiliar with disclosures search for companies without logging in, select two periodic reports from the same company, and check what changed.

> The service name (Dart Insight or 공시레이더) has not been decided yet. Planning, scope, and decisions are based on Notion. See the [documentation guide](#문서-안내) below.

## MVP Scope

**Flow:** Company search → Report selection → Comparison validation → Analysis in progress → Results (summary, financial figure changes, sentence changes) → Source check

| Category | Content |
| --- | --- |
| MVP (P1) | Company search, periodic report list and correction status, comparison report selection and comparability validation, financial account comparison, body and table change detection and prioritization, evidence-based summary, figure and sentence evidence with DART source locations, automatic checks for investment-solicitation expressions |
| Top-priority extension | Citation verification → audit log and Kill Switch → ML anomaly detection |
| Extension (P2) | Login, favorites, and new disclosure alerts; review, approval, and publishing; AI comparison criteria recommendations; section filters; sentence change history |
| Out of scope | Buy/sell recommendations, target prices, stock price forecasts |

The purpose and completion criteria for each issue are in [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/ShinhanDSProject/dart-insight/issues). Issues are managed only on GitHub.

## Tech Stack and Folders

| Folder | Role | Technology |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `frontend/` | Web UI | React + TypeScript |
| `backend/` | Service API, OpenDART lookup and caching, analysis job management | Spring Boot |
| `ai-server/` | Source parsing and structuring, sentence change detection, summarization and explanation | FastAPI, LangChain·LangGraph (Python) |
| `docs/` | Project overview and background research, API spec and ERD, collaboration guide | — |

- The database uses MariaDB (structured data) and Chroma (body text embeddings). External data comes from OpenDART.

# dsh-posterflow-ai

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) plugin that adds an “**Enable Image Generation Mode**” entry to the web interface sidebar. Clicking it **covers the entire window** with a transition animation, then navigates to [PosterFlow](https://www.posterflow-ai.xyz/).

# PosterFlow AI

## Online Use

Visit **[PosterFlow AI Online](https://www.posterflow-ai.xyz)**. No download or installation is needed; just open it and start using it. You can use the platform credits you get when you sign up, or use your own API Key to configure and control the API yourself.

> Your own key is stored only in the current browser tab. It is not written to the database, generation history, or cloud image storage. You will need to enter it again after closing the tab. Only use HTTPS endpoints provided by trusted vendors.

PosterFlow AI is an AI image workspace that brings everyday image generation, reference-image editing, local inpainting, and an infinite canvas together on one page. You can use it for posters, product images, social media graphics, or put multiple reference images together and have the model modify them according to your instructions.

## Key Features

The left-side mode switch corresponds to three different control methods:

### 1. AI Creation

- Enter a description to generate an image, or upload reference images for image-to-image generation.
- Use up to 8 reference images at once, and specify assets in the prompt with `@图1`, `@图2`.
- Supports batch generation, common aspect ratios, and quality settings.
- Generated results can be downloaded, previewed at higher magnification, have their prompts copied, or be further modified.

### 2. Local Inpainting

Select a generated result, and describe what you want to change, for example, “replace the background with a night scene, keep the person and composition.” The program automatically carries the original image into the next request. You can also start inpainting directly from an image in the gallery.

### 3. Infinite Canvas

Place generated images, materials from your computer, and text annotations on the same canvas. This is suited to organizing proposals, comparing compositions, and writing revision notes.

- Supports importing PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, and SVG files.
- Supports select, pan, arrow, rectangle, circle, brush, and text tools.
- The canvas is saved in the current browser, so you can keep editing after refreshing.
- The current selection or the entire canvas can be exported as PNG.
- “Canvas AI” can generate images matching the aspect ratio of a frame, or inpaint based on annotations.

## Get Started in Three Minutes

1. Open the [online version](https://www.posterflow-ai.xyz).
2. Sign up for an account, then click the confirmation link in your email.
3. In “AI Creation,” enter the scene you want to generate, or upload a reference image.
4. Choose an aspect ratio and quality, then click generate.
5. Download results from the gallery on the right, or continue inpainting or add them to the infinite canvas.

- `YYYY` → year
- `YYYYMMDD` → year, month, and day

# eext-simulation-with-simulide

A WebAssembly circuit simulation tool based on the SimulIDE engine, providing powerful in-browser circuit simulation for EasyEDA Pro.

This project is an EasyEDA extension plugin. It compiles the C++ simulation engine of SimulIDE to WebAssembly, enabling real-time circuit simulation in the browser.

## ✨ Features

- **WebAssembly compilation** - Based on Emscripten, the C++ simulation engine is compiled to WASM and runs efficiently in the browser

- **Real-time simulation** - Event-driven simulation engine that supports real-time interaction and dynamic component property updates

- **Rich component library** - Supports many circuit components, including BJTs, MOSFETs, diodes, resistors, inductors, logic gates, microcontrollers, and more

- **EasyEDA extension** - Integrated as an extension plugin and communicates with the EasyEDA platform through standard APIs

- **Data visualization** - Simulation data output in JSON format, pushed in real time to the EasyEDA interface

- **High performance** - Written in C++20 and optimized with O3, providing native-level computing performance

- **Cross-platform** - Supports building and deployment on Windows, Linux, and macOS

- **Extensible** - Event-driven plugin architecture, easy to extend and maintain

### How the extension plugin works

  LCEDA Pro platform

   - Extension manager

     - simulation-with-simulide extension plugin

       - TypeScript extension code (src/index.ts)

       - Event listener registration

       - Simulation control logic

       - Data push handling

    - WebAssembly module (WASM)

      - C++ engine

      - Circuit simulation computation

      - Component state management

incldue/CineFlow.body:
# CineFlow

A smooth, customizable desktop movie and TV recommendation app. (Published on the linux.do open-source community)

**CineFlow** is built with Electron + Vite. It uses TMDB as its data source with a Douban API fallback, and supports natural-language search, personalized recommendations, word-cloud-style search terms, Dynamic Island mode, unified management of video sources, in-app playback, and one-click casting to devices on the local network.

## Introduction

**CineFlow** is a desktop movie and TV show recommendation app focused on a clean UI, Dynamic Island mode, self-managed video sources, and in-app resume playback. It uses TMDB as its metadata source and supports discovery of movies, TV series, actors, keywords, and genres.

## Highlights

### Discovery and Browsing

- **Daily recommendations**: The home page shows today's movies and shows, with posters, ratings, genres, and synopses.
- **Dual movie and show search**: Covers both TMDB `movie` and `tv`, so TV series, variety shows, and programs can all be searched and recommended.
- **Dual-path search**: One path matches keywords against film titles. The other translates natural-language descriptions of weather, mood, and situations (humid southern spring weather, plum rain season, waiting at a high-speed rail station, late-night snacks, parties, background audio for housework…) into search intents. The results of both paths are merged and deduplicated.
- **Natural-language search**: Supports keywords such as movie titles, show titles, actors, and genres, and automatically expands them into related recommendations. It also offers expanded phrasing for weather, mood, and situations (humid southern spring weather, plum rain season, waiting at a high-speed rail station, late-night snacks, parties, background audio for housework…).
- **Three-page browsing with circular keyboard switching (`←` / `→`)**: Full-screen Home, Category Library, and Playback History views. `→` cycles through `Category Library → Playback History → Home`, and `←` cycles in reverse.
- **Category library**: Filter by media type and year in both directions. Scrolling down automatically loads more, with no page limit.
- **Search history**: A history panel appears below the search box. Search terms are shown as a word cloud or tag cloud. You can delete individual entries or clear them all, and a single click reruns the search.
- **Personalized recommendations**: Adjusts recommendations based on local clicks, favorites, and search preferences. (Requires applying for your own API key.)
- **Favorites panel**: A "Favorites" button in the top bar opens the favorites list from the left side. One click takes you to the details page for playback.
- **Dynamic Island mode**: When minimized, the app switches to a Dynamic Island. It supports dragging, expanding the search, snapping to screen edges, and one-click restoration of the main window. In island mode, extended pages collapse automatically and only the baseline island remains.

### Viewing and Resume Playback

- **In-app playback**: Supports HLS, DASH, and FLV. For TV series sources, the player can show the episodes of the current season and switch between them.
- **Playback history and "Continue Watching"**: Automatically records every title you watch, including the source, route, episode, and timestamp you last used. You can delete individual entries (with undo) or clear the history with restore.
- **Player casting**: A casting dialog inside the player. The main process uses SSDP to discover `MediaRenderer` devices and pushes the current address via SOAP. You can disconnect with one click. Local Bluetooth only lists wireless display and dock-type devices.
- **Ad segment filtering**: Three-level filtering removes ads from playback sources. Any error automatically falls back to the original manifest, so playback is not affected.

```text
apps-*.yaml       # App of Apps installation entry point

charts/           # Helm chart and deployment versions
env/              # Per-cluster configuration
scripts/          # Build, GitOps, validation, and operations scripts
requirements/     # Python runtime (runtime.txt) and test (dev.txt) dependencies
tests/            # Automated tests
docs/             # Operations documentation
```

The commands below are relative to the repository root. The scripts can also be run from other directories by specifying paths.

```bash
kubectl apply -n argocd -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/opspresso/argocd-env-apps/main/apps-k3s.yaml
```

# bsl-ai-toolkit — AI agent writes 1C code from the real code, not from memory

*AI agent toolkit for 1C:Enterprise 8.3 (BSL) development. MIT. Documentation is in Russian.*

A set of **rules, skills and MCP servers** for developing **1C:Enterprise 8.3 (BSL)** with an AI agent. The agent searches the code of your configuration and extensions, gets BSL Language Server diagnostics after every edit, and changes metadata (forms, DCS, attributes) with a deterministic engine verified in a test database. The reference implementation is Claude Code; Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, Codex, Cline, Windsurf and Aider connect through adapters built on the shared core. MIT license, no ties to any specific organization.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/vgtitov/bsl-ai-toolkit && cd bsl-ai-toolkit

```

## Adding news articles

Adding news articles requires **no environment setup**. If you have a GitHub account, you can add an entry :blush:

~~I think this is probably the easiest way...!!~~   
:new: **Now automated!!** :wrench::robot::dash::sparkles:

1. Open [_data/news.yml](https://github.com/yasslab/yasslab.jp/blob/main/_data/news.yml) in your browser
2. Click the ✎ icon on the right side of the screen (Fork this project and edit this file)
3. Add the news information
   - `title:` the title of the linked article
   - `date:` the publication date of the linked article
   - `url:` the URL of the linked article
4. Add a title and description to the change, then click Propose file change
5. Review the change, and if there are no problems, click Create pull request

That's it. Added news items are reviewed by other members, and if there are no problems, the proposed change is applied. Even if there is a problem, other members can notice it and fix it, so feel free to propose your change ;)

## Development steps
To develop or design locally, you need [Jekyll](https://jekyllrb.com).   
Once you're ready, set up with the following steps and start a local server.

1. `$ bundle install`
    - (First time only) Install gem libraries
2. `$ bundle exec jekyll server`
    - Start the local server
    - Once it's running, open `localhost:4000` in your browser

If successful, the same screen as [yasslab.jp](https://yasslab.jp/) will be displayed.
After that, edit the files you want to develop or modify as needed. (No restart required)
